answer_1.quote: We present the Multimodally-Enhanced Transformer for Explainable Recommendation (METER) ... generate textual explanations ... and image visualizations.
answer_1.outputs: textual explanation sentences and generated image visualizations

answer_2.quote: For explanation performance, we measure the text quality, diversity, and explainability ... we adopt BLEU-1 and BLEU-4, as well as ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 ... Unique Sentence Ratio (USR) ... Feature Diversity (DIV) ... Feature Matching Ratio (FMR) and Feature Coverage Ratio (FCR) ... CLIPScore (CS) ... RMSE and MAE for rating prediction.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a user study ... we asked 30 human subjects to provide a rating range from 1‑5, where larger scores represent better faithfulness and diversity ... we consider Faithfulness, Diversity, Consistency, and Quality as criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate generated explanations and images on a 1‑5 scale for Faithfulness, Diversity, Consistency, and Quality.
